name: plugin.chatbotx
description: ChatbotX omnichannel messaging, contact management, and visual flow automation bridge

entrypoints.name: chatbotx_list_contacts
entrypoints.description: Search and filter contacts across WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger, and other channels

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of contacts to return (default: 20)

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Filter contacts by channel (e.g. whatsapp, telegram, messenger)

entrypoints.name: chatbotx_send_message
entrypoints.description: Send an outbound text message to a contact on their active channel

entrypoints.name: chatbotx_trigger_flow
entrypoints.description: Trigger an automated visual flow DAG for a contact

parameters.name: flow_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the compiled flow to trigger

entrypoints.name: chatbotx_manage_tags
entrypoints.description: Add or remove a tag from a contact profile

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag name to attach or detach

entrypoints.name: chatbotx_query_conversations
entrypoints.description: List open chat conversations and unread queue counts across channels

entrypoints.name: chatbotx_broadcast
entrypoints.description: Dispatch a broadcast message to contacts matching an audience tag

parameters.name: audience_tag
parameters.description: Tag defining the recipient audience segment

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Optional channel filter for broadcast recipients

entrypoints.name: chatbotx_execute_tool
entrypoints.description: Execute a dynamic OpenAPI / MCP tool operation against the ChatbotX API surface

parameters.name: operation_id
parameters.description: OpenAPI operationId or MCP tool name (e.g. list_tags, block_contact)
